as_of_content:
In ''Transformers: Forged to Fight'', [[Commander]]s will eventually - if not inevitably - come upon '''Chips'''. These act as some sort of secondary currency (next to [[Gold]] and [[Energon]]) which can be used to purchase items in the [[Raid]] and Featured Bot Stores. Specialized chips also exist for events.

== Raid Chip ==
{{Main|Raid Chip}}

[[File:Raid-Chip.png|thumb|left]]
'''Raid Chips''' are a currency used to purchase items in the Raid Store. They are primarily earned through Raids, but they can be also earned through [[Away Mission]]s (prior to the Away Mission Update) and [[Alliance]] [[Objectives|Quests]].


== Featured Bot Chip ==
{{Main|Bot Chip}}

[[File:Jetfire Chip.png|thumb|left]][[File:Bot Chip.png|thumb|right]]
'''Featured Bot Chips''' ([[Jetfire]]'s seen left) are the primary method of obtaining new featured [[Bots]] of the month. For the 2019 year Featured Bot Chips were replaced with '''Generic Bot Chips''' (seen right).


== Arena Chip ==
{{Main|Arena Chip}}

[[File:Arena-Chip.png|thumb|left]]
'''Arena Chips''' were a currency used to purchase [[Arena]] [[Crystal]]s. They were earned from Away Missions, and in Arenas, but have been replaced with whole Arena Crystals.


== Special Chips ==
=== Class Clash Chips ===
'''Class Clash Chips''' were rewarded in the Class Clash Event and were used to purchase Class Crystals. (Image needed)

=== Generations Chips ===
[[File:Generations Chips.png|thumb|left]]
'''Generations Chips''' are the main reward for September 2019's 35th Anniversary Celebration.
